name: Compare printer quotes and calculate break-even for a print run with an AI financial planner
description: Compares printer quotes, calculates cost per copy and break-even for the print run, and compares the author's margin when self-publishing with a publisher's royalty.
shortDescription: Compare printer quotes, cost per copy and break-even, and self-publishing against a publisher deal.
keyFeatures: AI financial planner that reads printer quotes from a spreadsheet
Cost per copy and break-even for each print run size
Compares the author's margin when self-publishing with a publisher deal
Writes the comparison to a Google Doc
prerequisites: Google Sheets and Google Docs connections
A spreadsheet with printer quotes; replace REPLACE_WITH_PRINTER_QUOTES_SPREADSHEET_ID
idealFor: Self-publishers deciding how many copies to print and whether to go with a publisher.
steps: Read the printer quotes from Google Sheets.
The financial planner agent calculates cost per copy, break-even and both margins.
Write the comparison to a new Google Doc.
